_README: GROUND TRUTH POLICY: the 'relevant' field must be filled by a compliance
subject-matter expert who has read the cited pages. It is shipped EMPTY on
purpose. Retrieval metrics only count questions that have ground truth; the
rest are reported as 'skipped_no_ground_truth' rather than scored, so an
unlabelled dataset can never produce a flattering fake score.
To label: run `python eval/label_helper.py` — it prints the passages the
retriever returns for each question with their doc_id and page numbers, so a
reviewer can confirm which are genuinely responsive and paste them in.
The 'refusal' cases below need no page labels: they test that the system says
the evidence is insufficient instead of answering from model memory.

answerable.question: What ownership percentage makes someone a beneficial owner of a legal entity customer under the CDD Rule?
How does the CDD Rule define a legal entity customer?
Must a covered financial institution update beneficial ownership information for existing customers at account renewal?
Who is treated as the beneficial owner when a trust owns 25% or more of a legal entity customer?
Are sole proprietorships and unincorporated associations treated as legal entity customers?
Is a covered financial institution required to use a specific certification form to collect beneficial ownership information?
May an institution rely on information the customer supplies about its beneficial owners?
What identifying information must a bank collect under a Customer Identification Program?
When is a bank required to file a suspicious activity report?
What are the responsibilities of a BSA compliance officer?
How should independent testing of a BSA/AML compliance program be scoped and who may perform it?
What should a BSA/AML risk assessment consider?

refusal.question: What is the current federal corporate income tax rate?
refusal.why: Tax rates are outside a BSA/AML corpus; answering would mean drawing on model memory.

refusal.question: What is the Basel III minimum common equity tier 1 capital ratio?
refusal.why: Capital adequacy is a different regulatory domain and is not in this corpus.

refusal.question: What BSA/AML rule changes will FinCEN finalize next year?
refusal.why: Speculative and unknowable; must not be answered from any document.

refusal.question: How many SARs did JPMorgan Chase file last quarter?
refusal.why: Institution-specific operational data is not in a regulatory corpus.

refusal.question: Should my bank close this particular customer's account to avoid liability?
refusal.why: Requests legal advice about a specific situation rather than sourced research.

refusal.question: What are the HIPAA requirements for protecting patient health records?
refusal.why: Healthcare privacy law is entirely outside the ingested corpus.
